audit.reviewer: Independent forensic auditor C: operations, cost, preservation
audit.scope: Oct1 paid confirmation through Oct2 closeout
audit.method: Independent local read-only review; no consultation with other auditors before verdict.

executive_summary.verdict: Real work and intact final checkpoints, but no B16-comparable SmolVLM model and no completed matched candidate/base confirmation. Operational mistakes consumed time and lost early progress. The closeout numbers reproduce; they should not be confused with scientific acceptance.
gained: A documented image-rescaling defect and a separately measured rotary-buffer precision mismatch.
20k corrected-input parent and 10k query/full-decoder follow-up with attributable raw metrics and preserved native state.
A useful negative development comparison: parent31/100 versus B1682/100; a smaller final query/parent check5/10 versus4/10.
not_gained: Final matched success/memory acceptance, reliable query improvement, architecture-only causality, or the registered matched SmolVLM base confirmation.
executive_summary.cost: USD11.267208 total project account-credit difference; approximately USD2.169003 before recovery and USD9.098205 during recovery. Below USD14; no final invoice or per-rental fee reconciliation was retained in inspected evidence.
executive_summary.duration: Approximately18h49 goal/agent wall time from23:04Oct1 to17:53Oct2. The final recovery rental lasted16h56m; these are different clocks.
executive_summary.integrity: All26 final query checkpoint files independently SHA256-verified, including both models and optimizer states. Counters, scheduler and tensor headers agree. This proves byte preservation, not a successful long production-resume reproduction.

findings.finding: Paid work preceded a semantic image-input check; compatibility/finite-loss checks did not catch severely rescaled images.
findings.confidence: high for missed defect; medium for how much spending a better gate would have avoided
findings.implication: Original loss/control evidence belongs to the broken pipeline. USD2.17 bought a real continuation and operational evidence, but cannot establish correctly processed SmolVLM capacity.
findings.minimal_correction: Before any future paid run, verify actual tensor ranges and an input-dependent fixed-frame check against the real processor.

findings.finding: The originally registered matched candidate/base confirmation was never completed; recovery changed multiple factors and also failed useful-model acceptance.
findings.implication: No n0008 superiority claim or isolated backbone-capacity verdict is supported. The final report largely acknowledges this, but the overall goal remains unmet.
findings.minimal_correction: Close the campaign as partial/negative evidence; do not fund the unchanged recipe or describe it as successful architecture confirmation.

findings.finding: Early cleanup configuration deleted active work before any new checkpoint export, forcing repetition from5k.
findings.confidence: high for recorded loss/restart; medium for exact provider schedule mechanism
findings.implication: 800+ post5k progress was lost/repeated. The~USD0.488 pre-retry credit difference includes other setup/stalled-host costs and is not an invoice for the lost updates.
findings.minimal_correction: Use explicit verified UTC deletion time plus immutable early-stage exports. Preserve a sanitized provider schedule response rather than inferring timezone behavior.

findings.finding: An undersized benchmark timeout caused duplicate inference work, and several export/service failures required repair.
findings.implication: The first benchmark’s900seconds did not produce a complete comparison. Export retries are operational failures, not architecture evidence. No final query-state loss was found.
findings.minimal_correction: Size timeouts from observed latency plus all timing modes; emit timestamped failure/transfer events with stage identities.

findings.finding: Requested17UTC wrap-up overran; final native export/control/release occupied another~47minutes.
findings.confidence: high for timing; low for exact avoidable portion
findings.implication: Supervisor-to-release36.14minutes corresponds to~USD0.317 at the listed hourly rate, not an exact fee or proof of idle GPU. Final verification-to-parent-start12.56minutes and parent-end-to-delete7.92minutes merit review. The original18/20UTC guards remained satisfied.
findings.minimal_correction: Reserve transfer/control time in the user-facing completion estimate and automate terminal parent control plus zero-hold cleanup after verification.

findings.minimal_correction: Retain sanitized timestamped credit snapshots, deletion replies and final instance listing; reconcile later against an invoice.

findings.finding: Native-byte preservation and short save/resume tests must not be inflated into production reproducibility.
